<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Reservation policy:</strong> The Centre informed the Supreme Court that it opposes the exclusion of the &quot;creamy layer&quot; from SC/ST quotas, asserting that such policy decisions fall under the purview of Parliament rather than the judiciary.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary logjam:</strong> Both Houses of Parliament were adjourned until Monday following persistent disruptions by the Opposition, who are demanding a statement from the Home Minister regarding ongoing student protests.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxObEFob0lQYjMtZ254SldMQ3RTN01qeXVDYUpiV0VieDNQc29jcllSOG1vcW1aaGdtbTB2R2lGSWJaQVVfTjJvVU5fTjU1T1JOUFlsT2loTTc3M0daRzNkdm9wc2NoaGwwWlF4WHV1SUtCdzlTWEVUNURpLWVqVEdsOTY5WG9hVy01SkZFYzBOazJON1FGQ2xiZjBmaUx5T0JsNEVnSlZMNElBV3FHTFpuVmZpeDJJMlFrM1A0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative activity:</strong> Despite the ongoing deadlock, Parliament successfully passed the MSME Amendment Bill, legislation concerning UPI taxation, and a bill to appropriate excess expenditure for 2022-23.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxObEFob0lQYjMtZ254SldMQ3RTN01qeXVDYUpiV0VieDNQc29jcllSOG1vcW1aaGdtbTB2R2lGSWJaQVVfTjJvVU5fTjU1T1JOUFlsT2loTTc3M0daRzNkdm9wc2NoaGwwWlF4WHV1SUtCdzlTWEVUNURpLWVqVEdsOTY5WG9hVy01SkZFYzBOazJON1FGQ2xiZjBmaUx5T0JsNEVnSlZMNElBV3FHTFpuVmZpeDJJMlFrM1A0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQTllwRFVmQUdWQUw5SGFCSFV0MktWRDNhUm80LWpBNC1pUGtHNllBektrbFZ2bmtYZlVMT2tLVmFFRzFpRE5UalBSRHBESHBHdmo3UXBjeHZXVlRtQXZMbFdxTW9uTmowaGtYUmJfeXdjb0FSLXhkR05hTXFFc1ExNElzRzVzN1ZadzdiV0U5djBGWGdKb21paGkyV3p5Z3UyYWJDQmxfNzVuV0s5QXlqbWZzdw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPald6ZUhxalZ0X0tHSllReFJNeWUwVVl3bmFsNlR1OEdENzVfS18ydjdxNlc4dHRWTDNPbkM1bzNfQWdlakVUZnJZRFpHVk5VM081MUtLT2tteUdGd0ZGMlQ0VlBFcWFJZmRCSllOVzg5aFNKYUJBZkV1LXNvWmYyc19iTlQ2ZWdnUUpORWl1YkRIRUNFTGEtY0ZmZ3FaWXA0VmlwQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political alliances:</strong> Amidst speculation regarding future electoral partnerships, SAD leader Sukhbir Singh Badal met with Prime Minister Modi, while the BJP and Tipra Motha are reportedly considering an alliance for upcoming village committee elections in Tripura.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxNTWR2ZVhEbmowbExCdElqbUpDNFVfdy1UdjhUTmtnMWg1MEtMSjhjRHV1ZzJkNXJWdGVXZTl0WGZaR3pMZ28zZUh6ejhJcFA3QnVVZUE5R0JoTkJuUjdvNEo2MVp6UDZMS2NsQmVTcnVFTDI5X0o3VEhodVZDV2djamJ2NGFxQ1FUUXBBemFvcTU5a2NSNWcweGIxaVR4VGN1VHp1TVZlRm9hbVNBUElBSVhYdlFnTEVQZlBLOEVn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election administration:</strong> The Election Commission of India and State Election Commissioners concluded a National Round Table Conference in New Delhi to discuss electoral processes and institutional coordination.</li>
</ul>
